caption: The drawing depicts a wooden mantel clock with an octagonal face and a rectangular base. The clock's frame is made of brown wood with visible grain patterns and angular joints. The clock face is circular with a white background, black Roman numerals for the hours, and black minute markers forming a ring near the edge. There are two black clock hands and a gold decorative center with intricate detailing. Below the clock face, there is a rectangular panel featuring a colorful floral and fruit design with green leaves, red and orange fruits, and blue berries, set on a dark blue background. The clock door has a round metal knob on the left side and brass hinges on the right. The wood base is wide, flat, and slightly curved at the edges. The drawing is rendered in colored pencil or watercolor on a cream paper, and the artist's name, "FRANCIS LAW DURAND," is inscribed in the bottom right corner.
title: Alarm Clock (Timepiece)
